anna (PM): Hey team — final call on the PRD handoff. We need sign-off on requirements + acceptance criteria so eng can start the sprint. Sending the current checklist below. Please reply with any blockers by EOD.

jordan (Eng): skimmed it, looks mostly doable. Need clarity on SLOs for tail latency — 95th vs 99th?

maria (Design): will double-check the error states in the mockups (modal copy + empty states). Found one mismatch on 'no-embedding' flow.

lee (SRE): 95th is fine for initial launch, but if we expect spiky load from customer X we should aim for 99th in the dedicated rollout. Also we need a config for graceful downgrade to smaller model variant.

anna (PM): decision needed: set launch SLO to 95th (P0) and create a follow-up ticket to raise to 99th for Dedicated customers (P1). Does that work? @lee @jordan

jordan (Eng): OK for 95th now. Will add a fallback path for model-variant downgrade, but need acceptance criteria for correctness under fallback (no hallucination spike).

maria (Design): noted. I'll update mocks and include copy for the downgrade notice.

sam (Sales): From customer side, X insisted on 99th. Can we include a note in contract template about Dedicated SLA upgrade timeline?

anna (PM): yeah add a clause in the launch playbook and notify AE. We'll treat Dedicated SLA as separate commercial add-on.

anna (PM): Acceptance criteria (current PRD snippet):
```
- Functionality: API responds with structured JSON and status code 200 for valid requests. All required fields present.
- Latency: 95th percentile end-to-end under 400ms for the hosted tier under expected load profile.
- Correctness: model outputs must pass the prompt-set regression suite with >= 92% match on golden labels.
- Fallback: when model capacity is constrained, system should return a compatible fallback model with documented change in accuracy; no unhandled errors.
- Observability: per-route token-level metrics, error traces, and alerting on error-rate > 1% sustained for 5 minutes.
- Security: request logging redacts PII fields; keys rotated and audited.
```

jordan (Eng): Need one more AC item: deterministic seed for eval runs in CI to prevent flakiness.

anna (PM): added in doc. Edge cases called out in PRD: empty input, extremely long context (>64k tokens), mixed-language prompts, partially malformed JSON in tool-calls.

lee (SRE): For long contexts we should fail-fast with 413 and return a helpful error with suggested truncation. Also add rate-limiting headers.

maria (Design): will mock the 413 state and the truncation helper UI.

sam (Sales): After these updates I can present to customer X next Wed. Please flag anything that would change delivery date.

anna (PM): Timeline: ready for dev on Mon (sprint start). Go/no-go for the customer presentation requires eng + design sign-off by Tues 5pm.

jordan (Eng): Can sign off tentative technical approach today; will file follow-ups for fallback regression tests and CI seeds.

maria (Design): signing off on the mockups pending the 413 copy tweak.

lee (SRE): approve infra checklist, but need a runbook entry for fallback/rollback. I'll create it and link in the PRD.

qa-bot: QA checklist created: run regression-suite (golden prompts), chaos test for fallback path, long-context rejection tests.

anna (PM): great — final ask: please add your explicit sign-off message in this thread (e.g., "<name>: sign-off") so AEs have a record. I'll update the decision log after we have the messages.

jordan (Eng): jordan (Eng): sign-off

maria (Design): maria (Design): sign-off (will push 413 copy by EOD)

lee (SRE): lee (SRE): sign-off (runbook ticket created: INF-4721)

sam (Sales): sam (Sales): sign-off (will coordinate contract clause) :thumbsup:

anna (PM): anna (PM): sign-off — creating decision log entry and moving PRD to 'ready for dev'. Thanks everyone! :white_check_mark:
